items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Caterina Valente was a very big Italian star, and we played there on the Maggio Musicale

ctx.x: The Comedy was based on the Italian “Comedia…”

“Comedia del la Arte,” which was originally a condensation of the original Fontessa, which also had those characters from the “Comedia del la Arte.” When we first went to Italy, we played on a TV show there, Caterina Valente was a very big Italian star, and we played there on the Maggio Musicale, where we played these great prestige festivals…
